_comment: demo_facet.json with the WAM-Vs on xdyn,
riding one sea shared with every vessel and the Unity 6 renderer. The sea starts at
Beaufort 3 and follows the wind (Unity wind sliders, "follow_wind"). The WAM-Vs follow
the same patrol around their turbine as in demo_facet.json (three laps), with the xdyn
GNC pipeline of multi_vehicle_examples/wamv_xdyn.json instead of the kinematic model.
Each WAM-V has its own xdyn process (xdyn_port), so the five hulls are integrated in parallel.
